attempts.summary: Installed dnf versionlock plugin on node1 and added a lock for curl-0:7.76.1-40.el9.*, verified it prevents curl from being updated while other packages (e.g. libcurl) still upgrade normally. Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed and post-reboot curl remains pinned at the original version with the versionlock entry intact.
